name: Closed / Needs
source: Lynn, a troubled young woman, is trapped in an auditorium. She doesn't have any food, any water. What she can do however is understand herself. Try to make sense of her destroyed and abstract psyche.
translation: 林恩是一位陷入困境的年轻女子，她被困在礼堂里。她没有食物，也没有水。然而她能做的就是了解自己。尝试理解她被破坏和抽象的心理。
